sentences.en: Don't tell crude jokes in the presence of my father.
sentences.zh: 别在我爸爸面前讲低俗笑话。

sentences.en: A tanker is a ship that carries crude oil.
sentences.zh: 油轮是用来运输原油的船。

sentences.en: Does Algeria have the infrastructure to refine its own crude oil?
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚有没有能力自己提炼原油？
